rows.ARS:
Medium red Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: Ferry Porsche
rows.Origin:
Bred by Reimer Kordes (1922-1997) (Germany, 1971).
Introduced by Unknown (Australia) in 1976 as 'Ferry Porsche'.
rows.Bloom: Bright Red. None to mild fragrance. Double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season. Long sepals, pointed buds.
rows.Habit:
Upright. Dark green foliage.

Height: 30" to 5' (75 to 150cm).
rows.Parentage:
Tropicana (hybrid tea, Tantau, 1960) ×
Americana (hybrid tea, Boerner 1960)
